bookSourceComment: 多看漫画。搜索/详情/目录全部是纯 HTML（目录一次给全 682 章）；章节图地址被加密在 var params 里，由站点自己的 cms-2.0.1.min.js + crypto-js 解密，这里在 QuickJS 里直接跑站点脚本解包。
header: {"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36","Accept-Language":"zh-CN,zh;q=0.9","Accept":"text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8"}

ruleContent.content: @js:(function(){var html=String(result||'');var m=/var\s+params\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/.exec(html);if(!m)return '';var raw=m[1].replace(/\\\//g,'/').replace(/\\u([0-9a-fA-F]{4})/g,function(_,h){return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h,16));});if(!globalThis.__dkLibs){eval(java.ajax('https://www.duokanmh.com/static/libs/crypto-js/4.1.1/crypto-js.min.js'));eval(java.ajax('https://www.duokanmh.com/static/js/cms-2.0.1.min.js?v=1.0.2'));var o=CryptoJS.AES.decrypt;CryptoJS.AES.decrypt=function(c,k,g){var r=o(c,k,g);if(globalThis.__dkCap==null){try{globalThis.__dkCap=r.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex);}catch(e){}}return r;};globalThis.__dkLibs=1;}globalThis.__dkCap=null;try{CMS.chapter.decrypt(raw);}catch(e){return '';}var hex=globalThis.__dkCap;if(!hex)return '';var b=[];for(var i=0;i');}return out.join('\n');})()
